name: @neuropause/platform-operations
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Launch Workstream 1: Enterprise Production Infrastructure & Platform Operations. An additive package that composes Waves 1-14 and Sprints 1-6, unchanged, into the operational CONTROL-PLANE for production: cloud-environment/region/cluster/resource inventory (reusing the Sprint-2 infrastructure activation — clusters register with 0 running nodes until a real cluster reports); Kubernetes production descriptors (namespaces/deployments/services/ingress/statefulsets/autoscaling/PV/network-policies/pod-security/quotas/HPA/PDB, reusing the Sprint-1 deploy assets); production database descriptors for PostgreSQL/Redis/Qdrant (connection pools, health monitoring, replication descriptors, backup integration + restore validation reusing production); an API platform registry (gateway + auth/AI/integration/commercial/operations/admin APIs over REST/GraphQL/WebSocket); production networking descriptors (DNS/TLS/HTTPS/reverse-proxy/CDN/load-balancers/WAF/rate-limiting); identity activation (email/Google/Microsoft/MFA/org/session, reusing the Sprint-2 identity + security platforms); AI runtime operations (Ollama/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Azure adapters with model routing/usage-limits/failover/health, reusing the AI runtime); a storage platform (object/file/backup/log/artifact + lifecycle policies); CI/CD operations (build/test/release/rollback/hotfix, reusing the Sprint-6 release automation); a monitoring platform (Prometheus/Grafana/Loki/OpenTelemetry descriptors + dashboards); an operations center (cluster/service/database/queue/AI/deployment health + alert/incident center, reusing operations incidents); backup & recovery (reusing production backups + the Sprint-4 recovery validation); production security (Vault integration/secret rotation/certificate lifecycle/runtime policy/container verification, reusing security keys + infrastructure secrets/certificates); deployment automation (one-click/rolling/canary/blue-green/rollback, reusing release + production upgrade strategies); production validation (reusing the Sprint-4 end-to-end validation); operations documentation; an executive operations dashboard; and governance. The control-plane runtimes, descriptor registries, deployment automation, validation, operations center, governance, and documentation are LIVE-VERIFIED in-process; cloud providers (AWS/Azure/GCP), database engines (PostgreSQL/Redis/Qdrant), AI providers, the monitoring stack, Vault, and CDN/WAF are ADAPTER-VERIFIED until configured; real production traffic/customer-sessions/AI-usage/query-load/metrics are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING; and the live domain (app.neuropause033.com), running Kubernetes clusters, provisioned production databases, issued TLS certificates, production load balancers, and production object storage are INFRASTRUCTURE-PENDING. No live infrastructure, running cluster, provisioned database, issued certificate, or live domain is ever claimed unless configured and verified; every production operation is audited on the one chain with a replay id.
